positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what distinguishes owned intelligence from rented intelligence, and what is the asset retained?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around the individually-owned-intelligence thesis: src-1 draws the owned/rented distinction, src-2 identifies the substrate as commodity and perspective as the retained asset, and src-3 explicitly names the thesis these statements restate. The directional read spans the distinction, its grounding in commodity substrate vs perspective-as-asset, and the self-referential positioning of the thesis itself.
